keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Dominik Greif (Lyon).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Real Sociedad 1, Lyon 0. Orri Óskarsson (Real Sociedad) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Ander Barrenetxea with a cross.
Kaïl Boudache (Lyon) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
